title: Pre-existing import ceiling violation in orchestrator package (58 vs baseline 57)
description: The empty_subtask_guard.go stub file was committed with an import of internal/model, pushing the orchestrator package import count to 58, which exceeds the shrink-only baseline of 57 in constraints.toml. This violation existed before the recovery policy implementation and is not caused by the current changes.
reproduction_context: Run: go test ./internal/constraints/ — the 'Internal import ceiling' check reports 58 matches vs baseline 57. The stub file internal/orchestrator/empty_subtask_guard.go was committed in the TDD test-writing phase with `import "github.com/godinj/drem-orchestrator/internal/model"`. The baseline in .drem/constraints.toml is 57.
